description: Diversion-style or low-head run-of-river hydro project with intake, penstock, powerhouse, and tailrace. Schedules are dictated by in-stream work windows and FERC licensing conditions.
hard_deadline_themes: PPA COD with hydrologic season alignment

typical_risks.description_template: Sole-source Francis/Kaplan unit from {oem} has {weeks}-week lead time with limited expediting leverage.
License article requires functional downstream fish passage at COD; testing protocol with USFWS unresolved.
Differing site conditions in dam foundation excavation reveal sheared rock requiring redesigned anchorage.
Specialty underground crews are committed to peer projects; mobilisation premium of {pct}% expected.
Cofferdam overtopping risk during freshet could flood powerhouse excavation for {weeks} weeks.
State fish & wildlife window restricts in-water work to {months}, with no extension mechanism.

typical_risks.category: Client scope on fish ladder design
typical_risks.description_template: Client requests enhanced ladder design to support broader anadromous species, mid-execution.
Reservoir flushing protocol contested by downstream users; could require operational redesign.

typical_issues.description_template: Higher-than-modeled seepage requires supplemental dewatering pumps.
RT inspection flagged {pct}% weld rejection rate on penstock segments.
Runner arrived with surface damage requiring OEM field repair.
Early arrival of monitored species triggered early shutdown of in-water work.
{n_anchors} rock anchors failed proof load and require redrill.
Cold-weather pour resulted in cold joint requiring repair.
Quarterly compliance filing slipped, prompting agency inquiry.
Initial wet commissioning revealed scour patterns requiring riprap augmentation.
Section 106 consultation extended after artifact discovery near intake.
